cases.source: Synthetic scenario modelling defect classes seen in a web test suite: sets chosen by styling class and every/none checks over an unchecked set. No code or data from that suite.
cases.rationale: Universal checks over a collected set pass on an empty legend unless its size is asserted; class-selected sets break on a restyle.

cases.source: Synthetic scenario modelling a defect class seen in a web test suite: absence checks without a presence control. No code or data from that suite.
cases.rationale: An absence check on a locator nothing matches passes for ever; a presence control with the same locator makes it able to fail.

cases.rationale: Without test ids and with production frozen, roles are the stable selection and an empty state legitimately has zero rows.
